question: What did you suggest I do about the squeaky floorboard?
answer: Drive a screw through the board into the joist beneath it

haystack_sessions.content: I am trying to cut down on how much oil the weeknight stir fry takes.
A carbon steel pan at high heat needs far less. Preheat it before anything goes in.
The floorboard outside the bedroom squeaks every single night.
Drive a screw through the board into the joist beneath it to pull the two tight.
We are deciding between Lisbon and Porto for four days in October.
Porto is smaller and easier to walk. Lisbon has more day trips within reach.
